Map a group's segments under two rules, by grade, and its floodplain by the grade beside it

Source: R/compare_map.R
knw_compare_map.Rd

Three readings of one group for one species and stage, each as a static figure (tmap, lakes and rivers styled through gq's registry) and, when html is given, an interactive page (knw_compare_mapgl(), saved self-contained):

  • rules: accessible segments coloured kept (habitat under both rules), lost (default only), gained (tuned only), neither;

  • grade: accessible segments shaded by grade class;

  • floodplain: the floodplain cells shaded by the grade of the segment that owns them (fp_cells, from knw_floodplain_ha()'s join), where given.

Usage

knw_compare_map(
  segments,
  water = NULL,
  title = "",
  png = NULL,
  html = NULL,
  fp_cells = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  panels = c("rules", "grade", "floodplain"),
  mark = NULL,
  lwd = 1,
  legend = TRUE,
  labels = NULL,
  background = c("voyager", "openfreemap", "esri_topo")
)

Arguments

segments

an sf in EPSG:3005 with accessible, stream_order, grade_class and the two logical rule columns flag_default and flag_tuned.

water

an sf of lake and river polygons for the group, or NULL.

title

character(1) names the figure in the message when nothing is drawn, and is the interactive page's title and legend title; the static figure draws no title (that belongs in the caption).

png

character(1) path for the static figure, or NULL: one panel for each of panels that can be drawn ("floodplain" needs fp_cells), ncol to a row.

html

character(1) path for the interactive page, or NULL.

fp_cells

NULL, or a SpatRaster of grade per floodplain cell.

ncol

integer(1) panels per row in the static figure, or NULL for all panels side by side; each panel is 4 in by 4.6 in, so ncol = 1 stacks them for a narrow column.

panels

character which static panels to draw, any of "rules", "grade" and "floodplain" (drawn only where fp_cells is given).

mark

NULL, or an sf polygon outlined on every static panel, such as the window of a zoomed map drawn by a second call on cropped segments.

lwd

numeric(1) multiplier on the static panels' line widths, for a zoomed window where stream-order widths read too thin.

legend

logical(1) draw the static panels' legends; FALSE for a zoomed panel beside an overview that carries them.

labels

NULL, or an sf of points with a label column, drawn as numbered markers on every static panel (examples a table beside the map describes).

background

passed to knw_compare_mapgl() for the interactive page.

Value

Invisibly, the paths written.

Details

Line widths follow stream order so a group's mainstem reads over its headwaters, and the legend names every class drawn.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
knw_compare_map(seg, water, "BULK: CH rearing, default against the tuned rule",
                png = "research/fig/compare_ch_rear_bulk.png")
} # }
